# Vertical overlay: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting

**Level:** NAICS 2022 sector 11 (parent vertical)
**CISA critical infrastructure sectors nested here:** Food and Agriculture
**Primary industry for Cris Santos Company:** NAICS 111998 All Other Miscellaneous Crop Farming. Precision-agriculture crop farm using connected irrigation, drones, and farm-management software.
**Primary system:** Farm management and irrigation control platform

## Regulators and sector risk management agency
U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) - co-SRMA for Food and Agriculture; Food and Drug Administration (FDA/HHS) - co-SRMA; FSMA food defense; Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - pesticides, agricultural environmental rules

## Primary regulation for the gap analysis (P03)
**NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0**, NIST CSWP 29 (Feb. 26, 2024). Primary agricultural production has no binding federal cybersecurity regulation (farms are largely exempt from 21 CFR 121, which is a food-defense, not IT-security, rule). CSF 2.0 is the sector-neutral baseline referenced by USDA/CISA; use 21 CFR 121 as a supplemental checklist for any farm mixed-type facility that processes food.
Source: https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/cswp/29/the-nist-cybersecurity-framework-csf-20/final

## Sector context
- **Sensitive data:** Farm operational and yield data; Employee PII / H-2A worker records; Food defense plans and vulnerability assessments; USDA program participant data; Payment card data (PCI DSS) for direct sales
- **Critical systems:** Precision-agriculture platforms and GPS/GNSS guidance; Connected tractors/equipment telematics; Irrigation and grain-handling PLC/SCADA; Livestock/dairy automation and environmental controls; Cold-chain monitoring; Farm ERP/accounting
- **Sector AI rules and guidance:** None identified beyond cross-sector obligations
- **Assurance alternatives to SOC 2:** None noted
- **Scenario incident (P08):** Ransomware on farm-management and irrigation control systems
- **Scenario AI use case (P10):** Computer-vision crop yield prediction

## Notes
No sector-wide mandatory cyber rule for primary agriculture. CIRCIA proposed rule would cover food & ag entities only via the SBA size-standard criterion (no ag-specific sector criterion). Cross-cutting (not repeated per unit): public companies in any sector are subject to the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rule (17 CFR 229.106 / Reg. S-K Item 106 annual disclosure; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of determining an incident is material; effective Sep. 5, 2023): https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2023/08/04/2023-16194/cybersecurity-risk-management-strategy-governance-and-incident-disclosure
